Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
RMI server implementation handling connections and inbound requests from remote clients. Forwards respective actions to the LobbyController and manages dedicated asynchronous threads to safely deliver outbound events to clients via the NetworkLayer.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(VirtualClientRmi client, String nickname)
      Connects a remote client and initializes a buffer flushing thread to send pending events asynchronously. Also handles connection rejection by notifying the client of duplicate nicknames.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface VirtualServerRmi
      Parameters:
      client - the remote reference to the VirtualClientRmi representing the user.
      nickname - the selected username for the player.
